blocks.text: Esters carboxylic acids ke derivatives hain jo un ke alcohols se reaction se bante hain. Alcohols aur carboxylic acids ke baraks esters apne molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds nahi bana sakte, is liye un ke ubalne ke darje mutaliqa alcohols aur carboxylic acids se kam hain: ethyl ethanoate, CH3COOC2H5, 77 C par ubalta hai, jo dikhata hai ke yeh ethanoic acid aur ethanol se zyada urne wala hai. Hydrogen bonding na hone se esters paani mein bhi kam ghulte hain. Bohat se esters meethi, phalon jaisi khushbu wale maaye hain, aur solvents aur phalon ke mashroobat aur mithaiyon mein zaiqe ke taur par use hote hain; bohat se phalon ki khushbu aur zaiqa esters ki wajah se hai.

blocks.prompt: Ethyl ethanoate ethanoic acid se kam darje par kyun ubalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Ester molecules mein O-H group nahi, is liye yeh aapas mein hydrogen bonds nahi bana sakte; sirf kamzor quwwatein unhein thaamti hain.

items: Esters: molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonding nahi, kam b.p. (ethyl ethanoate 77 C), kam ghulte.
Phalon jaisi khushbu: solvents aur zaiqe.
